verdict: Corrective source and detailed review delivered. Not a declaration that the live website is fully ready for paid intake.

fullLocalGate.scope: check:deploy after public design/learning/payment/readiness changes; before final overview-count and privileged-runtime-reader followups. These followups then received targeted behavior/contracts and final type/lint/build validation.

readinessBehavior.scope: Actual normalization/getContentReadiness with injected provider reads: valid/invalid settings, errors, no slots, missing runtime/calendar, unconfigured, unauthorized elevated RPC read denied.

learningBehavior.scope: Actual LearnClient with injected actions/frame: serialize admissions, lesson drafts, repeat submit guard, exception recovery, durable deletion feedback, keyboard tabs, popup null and throwing-policy fallback. No real protected media or persistent provider writes.

overviewBehavior.scope: Exact-count replies above 20, genuine zero versus unavailable, and financial aggregate completeness guard. Injected provider reads, not provider history/RLS or real currency-account acceptance.

publicRoutes.scope: Final public visual source, no horizontal document overflow or page JS exceptions; not comprehensive accessibility.

finalNextSmoke.scope: Actual provider-free home/tour, owner password UI, central guard redirect and complete simulated booking; no live signup/payment/storage.

vinextCheck.scope: Static configuration/structure scan only; not full workload compatibility or Free CPU acceptance.

dependencyAudit.scope: Existing pinned braces native pnpm guard retained; not an upstream fixed version.

releaseIntegrity.scope: Manifest lengths/hashes and source/archive security checks.

livePublicInspection.scope: Read public site and navigate only through service/date/time/contact step. Did not fill fields, create account, submit booking or send email. Deployed version/database not identified.

notPerformed: No live provider login, migration, owner enrollment, purchase, receipt upload or email delivery
No real protected-media playback, persistent course notes or entitlement denial acceptance
